purpose: estimate the effort for planned work in a way the team can calibrate and improve against actual results
entry_criteria: Past delivery data exists or can be collected
The team doing the work is available to estimate
procedure: Have the people who will do the work estimate it, with the item and acceptance criteria in front of them.
Use a relative or range method and compare with similar completed items rather than guessing from nothing.
Split items that are too large to estimate with confidence, and note what remains unknown.
Convert to a delivery forecast using past throughput, giving a range and a confidence level.
Record the estimate and assumptions, then compare with actuals when each item completes.
Use the differences to adjust the method and the forecast.
acceptance_criteria: The forecast is a range based on past throughput

validation.check: compare estimates and actuals for the last ten completed items
check every item over the size limit has been split

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A team's last ten items averaged 1.4 times their estimates, so the forecast for the next release is stated as eight to twelve weeks with a note that the range reflects that history.
